question: What becomes dear to yoginīs through great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation?
premises: yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet states the result
inference: Great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to yoginīs.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation of mahā to siddhiḥ
plain_english: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment make one dear to the yoginīs.
